title.narrative: The future of The School of Dialogue and our partnership

description.narrative: The Ambassadors of Dialogue project groups from Egypt and Denmark respectively, will get together in Cairo in October 2024 to develop and design the future of our partnership and our shared future partnership project. The partners are currently implementing a pilot project, The School of Dialogue in Egypt, and as this project is coming to an end this year, we wish to get together to shape our future and to strengthen our partnership by - in the spirit of the project - have an inclusive and engaging dialogue, inviting volunteers both from Denmark, and most importantly Egyptian volunteers who are currently part of the project implementation. We will particularly focus on the theme of structures for sustainable volunteering structures in our partnership. We truly believe in the future of our partnership and collaboration - and see this as being an important milestone in road to creating change together in a challenging context for Egyptian youth.
